summary:
FMLink and The McMorrow Reports, in partnership with ORGATEC, publish a promotional Q&A with Maik Fischer, Director of ORGATEC 2026, previewing the trade fair in Cologne, Germany, October 27-30, 2026. The piece targets North American facility planners and managers, architects, interior designers, workplace strategists and contract furniture professionals, positioning ORGATEC as the lead European event for exploring workplace and commercial interiors including furniture, lighting and textiles.

Key points from the interview:

Theme: the 2026 edition runs under "From Rooms to Relationships: Designing Spaces in an Ever-Changing World," framed around creating more connected, flexible and sustainable work environments.

Exhibitors: Fischer says the show draws a highly international audience with strong participation from Germany and Europe plus global exhibitors. Named brands include Humanscale, Interface, Kinnarps, Sedus, Thonet, Muuto and Framery.

Trends: hybrid work, AI, sustainability and employee well-being are described as central themes across the exhibition and the accompanying Wherever Whenever - Work Culture Festival, with conferences, guided tours and interactive programs.

Why travel: Fischer argues North American attendees gain direct access to Europe's workplace design market, an international network of manufacturers, architects, designers and corporate decision-makers, and products or concepts not yet widely available in North America.

Logistics: tickets are priced at EUR 105 per person for all show days and include free public transportation access. Attendees are pointed to the ORGATEC ticketshop and event app for scheduling meetings and identifying exhibitors. Fischer advises first-time visitors to plan ahead but leave room for unexpected conversations.

The article also mentions a circular biomaterial focus area exhibit and lists North American contact details for Koelnmesse Inc. in Chicago (Kasia Myzia, Sales and Project Manager, North America).

The piece is event marketing rather than research or analysis; it contains no data on workplace utilization, attendance or technology adoption.

claims.claim: ORGATEC 2026 will be held in Cologne, Germany, October 27-30, 2026
Tickets cost EUR 105 per person for all show days, including free access to public transportation
Leading exhibiting brands include Humanscale, Interface, Kinnarps, Sedus, Thonet, Muuto and Framery
Hybrid work, AI, sustainability and employee well-being are central themes of the exhibition and the Wherever Whenever Work Culture Festival
ORGATEC attracts a highly international audience with strong participation from Germany and across Europe
North American visitors can discover products and concepts not yet widely available at home
